data_objects.name: dated_group_scores
data_objects.meaning: Dated score observations assigned to integer-coded groups.

variables.name: group_id
variables.meaning: Integer categorical identifier for the group associated with the observation.

variables.name: score
variables.meaning: Continuous score on an undocumented scale.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as an eight-digit YYYYMMDD value.

structure.description: Each row is a score observation at a group and application date; group_id and apply_date are the main grouping dimensions.

uncertainties: The business meaning of group_id and the direction or calibration of score are not documented in the file.
annotation_notes: Treat group_id as categorical even though it is represented by integers.
